objective: Create a 9:16, 30 FPS original RC high-pass explainer based on the supplied reference's generic information structure, with theme-driven colors, bounded typography, voice-first timing, a Jianying review draft, and mandatory post-render quality checks.
constraints: Output is 1080x1920 portrait at 30 FPS; no C-drive outputs.
Use topic-derived palette; pink is not a global background default.
Remotion is the only deterministic picture renderer; HyperFrames supplies layout/timing rules only.
jianying-editor-skill is the only Jianying backend; CapCut Mate and JianYing MCP remain disabled.
HeyGen may be attempted only for newly generated narration or a non-authoritative benchmark; source audio is never uploaded or reused.
No source frames, source audio, full source transcript, watermark, creator identity, or recognizable source shot sequence enters the output.
Every render runs the post-render layout/media/black-frame/audio/decode gate before a Jianying draft is created.
Automatic Jianying export, desktop UI automation, publication, Feishu, Cron, and PROJECT_STATUS phase promotion remain disabled.
acceptance: RC high-pass script and storyboard contain five original beats and verified formulas.
Every visible text box has a declared safe rectangle and bounded font/line policy; layout gate passes at all chapter sample frames.
Remotion output is visual-only, 1080x1920, 30 FPS, H.264, full-decodes, and has no burned-in subtitles.
One timing manifest drives Remotion scene windows, Jianying VoiceOver segments, and one native subtitle track.
Assembled preview has audible AAC, source audio is absent, and post-render quality report is pass or explicitly human-review-required.
New Jianying draft is written on E:, automatic export is false, and manual listening/export remains open.
rollback: Remove only the new scoped commit and preserve prior Flash/watchdog candidates, reports, and Jianying drafts.
